node.statement: Put the primal from 1.2 in max-with-free-variables form with x=(u,t), objective t, and inequalities u.d_i<=1, -u.d_i<=0, and t-u.d_f<=0. The dual of a finite maximization LP with free variables and <= inequalities uses nonnegative multipliers on those inequalities and imposes equality of the coefficient vector with the primal objective vector.
